26b0dce6dded6bf881a97ff709bd7481689fc770: Finkenberg offers 142 km of well-marked runs – an intermediate-sized ski area ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever skiing exactly the same thing twice. The 61 lifts are generally sufficient to handle the flow in high season. Technical terrain reigns at Finkenberg: with 23 black and 46 red runs on the programme, experienced skiers will find plenty to challenge them. Off-piste and freeride are practised here in often excellent conditions, thanks to the altitude and the orientation of the slopes. With a summit at 2500 m and a village at 840 m, snow reliability at Finkenberg is generally dependable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can create tension early in the season, but the situation recovers quickly with the first serious snowfalls. The budget for a stay at Finkenberg is clearly high: €82 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence – but it is wise to be aware of it before you go. In short: Finkenberg lives up to its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
